findings.title: Preserve integer DOF indices in the predictor API
findings.problem: frozen_array always coerces to float64. Thus the valid integer prescribed_dofs supplied to solve_step reach custom predictors as float64, breaking normal NumPy/Torch indexing. The built-in features function silently casts them back and the existing shape test does not expose the public-interface error.
findings.evidence: Exact ed7 git-object solver + algebraic fixture: predictor received dtype float64, writeable False.
findings.required_fix: Pass an immutable int64 array and add a custom predictor that performs integer indexing; retain float64 field/value arrays.

findings.title: Do not certify a used but unidentified predictor as NN_OFF
findings.problem: Any custom predictor without model_id is currently executed, yet the accepted certificate uses getattr(...,"NN_OFF"). The same label conflates attempted model, rejected/fallback initial guess, and NN-disabled baseline, corrupting paired-method provenance.
findings.evidence: Exact ed7 git-object solver completed one network_inference call and certificate model_id was NN_OFF.
findings.required_fix: Validate a nonempty string model identity before any model/scientific call. Bind actual initializer role/model and any attempted/rejected predictor/fallback reason separately in the certificate/work ledger; test unidentified and fallback paths.

findings.title: Charge host CPU work during GPU training and inference
findings.problem: 124 wall/1984 core-hour CPU envelope is exactly120 numerical+4 setup/IO; it leaves no declared allowance for host CPU preprocessing/training/inference associated with the12 GPU hours. A total-cost budget cannot omit that work.
findings.required_fix: Add an explicit conservative host allowance or account for the overlap without double-counting. Proposed sequential12 host wall hours at <=16cores yields136 total wall/2176 core-hours; keep a single <=16core host envelope and retain all GPU caps. These remain unprofiled proposals.

findings.title: Distinguish a seen c1 sequence from a qualified complete trajectory
findings.problem: The five accepted c1 substeps are reported as independent_complete_trajectories=1 even though the report explicitly establishes zero new-backend certified labels, no disjoint full-trajectory split and no degraded-fatigue coverage. The field can be mistaken for available complete training/evaluation trajectories.
findings.required_fix: Report seen_sequences=1 separately from qualified_complete_trajectories=0 (and retain five candidate transitions/zero certified labels). Update the generator and new audit receipt; preserve the old v1 artifact as history.
